- Small medical clinics with high appointment no-show rates.
- Front-desk staff who spend time on reminders and scheduling questions.

- Missed appointments reduce revenue and delay patient care.
- Staff time is consumed by repetitive scheduling communication.

- Send automated appointment reminders and answer common scheduling questions.
- Escalate complex or sensitive cases to front-desk staff.

- Reduce no-show rate for the pilot patient group.
- Track staff handoffs, patient satisfaction, and reminder response rate.

- Assumption: patients will trust and respond to AI scheduling messages.
- Next test: run a small pilot and compare no-show rate against a baseline.
